issues: Probe 'insufficient-precision-3-dec' declares check_ids including structure_ca_core, structure_mass_weighted and structure_resid_weighted, and its rationale states 'all six per-file structural and RMSD-value checks necessarily fail'. The executed control (which also misplaced one value, writing frame f with value f+1) shows the three value checks failing, the three structural checks passing, and time_frames_consistency passing, and is recorded as a failed control (passed_control: false; 14/15 expected outcomes met under control_summary). Correct the expected failing checks to the three rmsd_values_* checks only.

Probe 'insufficient-precision-3-dec' rationale claims 'The Time (ns) cells also round (< 1e-6 ps)'. The script's loop `for j in range(2, ncols)` never touches the Time column (index 1), and the executed report shows time_frames_consistency passing against the reference Times. Remove or correct this claim.

Probe 'wrong-time-exactly-1ps' rationale claims 'all 98 data rows violate |t-r| <= 1e-6 ps against the reference'; the executed grader report records 87/98 time values outside tolerance, first frame 11. This matches the arithmetic (the script writes frame f with value f+1; deviation (f+1)*8.8e-8 ps crosses 1e-6 at frame 11) and the suite's own concern note, but the rationale sentence must reflect the executed measurement.

The currently failing 'insufficient-precision-3-dec' control must be described accurately, and after correcting the probe annotations/expected check IDs, all affected controls must be re-executed on the revised candidate; the failed record stays attached to the current candidate hash and must never be redescribed as passing.
rationale: The grader code, public acceptance contract and executed reference/empty/misplaced/missing/recomputed/alternative controls are sound, and the executed independent solution (own PSF/DCD readers, from-scratch Kabsch) passing all seven checks at the declared 5e-6 + 1e-6|r| tolerance supports the tolerance with executed evidence (max 5e-7 A agreement; boundary probe at 2e-6 relative error correctly fails 174/392 cells). Source coverage is complete and both notebook exclusions are structurally valid. However, the probe suite has expected-outcome/annotation defects contradicting the executed control records: (1) insufficient-precision-3-dec expects the three structure_* checks to fail and claims Time cells round, but the executed control shows the three structural checks passing, the Time column untouched by its script (loop range(2, ncols)), and the control recorded as failed (control_summary: 14/15 expected outcomes met); (2) wrong-time-exactly-1ps claims all 98 rows violate the time tolerance while the executed report shows 87/98, first frame 11, consistent with the (f+1)*8.8e-8 ps accumulated deviation and the suite's own concern note. The mutation scripts, intended overall fail outcomes and underlying grader rejections all behaved correctly, so this needs corrected annotations and re-execution rather than a different task or contract.

source_coverage.rationale: The three required CSVs correspond exactly to the terminal stored DataFrames of the notebook (df, df_mass, df_charge) that exports.py exports unmodified, with all columns preserved. Excluded branches check out against the source: the universe-level backbone/CORE/LID/NMP table has both R and df overwritten by the later AtomGroup cell (verified in original.py), so no eligible stored result exists at completion; the standalone rms.rmsd(backbone, backbone) value is an unnamed, never-stored expression; the matplotlib plots are visual renderings of tabular results already exported. The public brief's mass-weighted domain weighting (contradicting the notebook narrative that the groups remain unweighted) is matched by the frozen executed reference and independently supported by execution: the from-scratch independent solution mass-weights the domain groups (tab2 uses mass[j]) and passed all rmsd_values_* checks against the reference at 5e-6 A, an agreement an unweighted-domain reference could not attain for N/CA/C/O heterogeneous masses. No eligible endpoint in the original source is missing from the preparation inventory.
remaining_validation: Harbor packaging-stage isolation and oracle checks, and blind-solver validation, remain to be performed after this review; this source audit does not establish them.
